I was reminded yesterday that I wrote an online "mini-textbook" on consolidation accounting in 2024 and you can read it here: [Consolidation accounting](https://iangow.github.io/consol/)

The source code is all here: [Quarto source code](https://github.com/iangow/consol)
It is easy to render into a website or into a PDF.

My goal was to have material for teaching consolidations that wasn't embarrassingly awful and made it possible for a motivated student (i.e., a tiny, perhaps non-existent, minority) to get a comprehensible view on the topic.

(Note that one teaches consolidation accounting very differently in Australia under IFRS than one does in the US. Somehow US accounting textbooks seem to put a lot of the details outside both intermediate and advanced accounting.)
